headline: CHUNCKYM DROPPED 152.02 AND THE LEAGUE IS STILL PICKING UP TEETH 🦷

sections.heading: THE MONARCH CAME OUT OF THE SHADOWS 👑
sections.body:
Last week ChunckyM was the punchline. Eleven transactions, a kicker carousel, 29.3 points of receiver glued to the bench, one loss. This week he put up 152.02 — the highest score anybody has managed in 2026 by twenty and a half points — and did it while his two starting running backs, Jonathon Brooks and Chris Rodriguez, combined for 2.9. TWO POINT NINE. 🫠

Josh Allen went 46.8. Jaxon Smith-Njigba went 38.0. And the two guys he famously benched in Week 1? Parker Washington and Matthew Golden started this time for 21.1 between them. The Panthers defense he grabbed off the wire Saturday: 21.7. The kicker he grabbed off the wire: Chase McLaughlin, 16.0. Every single lever he pulled worked. 🎰

The victim was muahuavang's Ulysseus, who scored 100.02 and lost by exactly 52.00. Not 51.98. Not 52.03. Fifty-two point zero zero. The universe wanted the number round so it would look better on the tombstone. ⚰️

sections.heading: TREVOR LAWRENCE II: THIS TIME HE STARTED HIM 🎬
sections.body:
You are not going to believe this. Keeneng, who last week started Matthew Stafford for 4.1 while Trevor Lawrence went 34.1 on his bench, LEARNED HIS LESSON. He started Trevor Lawrence. Corrected the error. Faced the mistake like a man. 🫡

Trevor Lawrence scored 6.2. Matthew Stafford scored 35.0 from the bench. Keeneng lost by 3.32. 💀

Let that settle. Two weeks, two quarterbacks, the same two names, and the wrong one started both times — by a combined 58.7 points. Davante Adams gave him 35.5 and it did not matter. Erling Haaland is 0-2. At this point the kindest thing this league could do is take his phone. LOL. 📵

Honorable co-sufferer: VangMushu, who fixed HIS Week 1 error too — benched Drake Maye (8.0), started Jayden Daniels (16.7) — and lost by 3.82 anyway, because Saquon Barkley decided 2.5 was a number a first-round pick could post. Redemption is a scam. 😤

sections.heading: WHO ACTUALLY SHOWED UP 🔥
sections.body:
Josh Allen 46.8 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba 38.0 own the top of the board. Behind them, a dead heat at 37.8 between Jared Goff for imbackbeech and Dak Prescott for jayvang100 — both of whom won, which is a nice change from Week 1 when every big score was attached to a loser.

Mahomes put 35.0 on the board for mouavang86, matching Stafford's bench number exactly, because this league runs on cruel symmetry. CeeDee Lamb woke up for 31.3 for Tub89, Amon-Ra St. Brown went 30.7 again for Hvang94, and Jonathan Taylor's 27.2 for Evz132 was completely wasted.

And the tight ends! After Week 1's group humiliation, Travis Kelce (20.6), Dalton Schultz (20.0), Dalton Kincaid (19.0), George Kittle (16.0) and Sam LaPorta (14.2) all remembered they get paid to catch footballs. Meanwhile Dallas Goedert — 21.7 last week — posted 0.9, and Tucker Kraft managed 2.5. The position isn't fixed, it just rotated who's embarrassed. 🔄

sections.heading: THE BENCH REMAINS THIS LEAGUE'S BEST TEAM 🪑
sections.body:
KevinVang lost by 7.41 with Stefon Diggs (19.2) and Jake Ferguson (18.3) watching in street clothes. That's 37.5 points, five times his margin, and he paid for it twice over because Jaxson Dart — 32.6 in Week 1, the sentence that made everyone check the app — came back with 0.8. He also dropped the Bears defense to add the Chiefs defense, who rewarded him with 0.2. Michelob Plus Ultra, now with less flavor. 🍺

jayvang100 benched Brock Purdy for the second straight week, this time for 32.5, AND sat Tre Tucker's 20.4, and won by 7.41 anyway on the strength of Dak and a kicker. Brandon Aubrey's 16.0 outscored five of his nine starters. His Jaguars defense scored 0.0 — not negative, not positive, just present. 🫥

cvang1990 gets the grim prize: 131.56 in Week 1, league best. 83.75 in Week 2, second worst. Denzel Boston (18.0), Rachaad White (11.3) and Romeo Doubs (11.1) put up 40.4 from the couch. He picked Boston up HIMSELF this week and still didn't start him. That's not bad luck, that's a filing error. 📂

sections.heading: WAIVER WATCH 📋
sections.body:
Dalton Schultz is the pickup of the week: imbackbeech grabbed him, dropped Bo Nix to do it, started him immediately and got 20.0 in a 47.73-point demolition of cvang1990. Clean, decisive, ruthless. Nobody else came close to that hit rate. ✅

ChunckyM stayed busy but finally busy in the right direction — Panthers DEF for 21.7, Chase McLaughlin for 16.0, both started, both cashed. He did also sign Jonah Coleman, then drop Jonah Coleman to re-sign Kendre Miller, the same man he'd dropped days earlier to get McLaughlin. Even in triumph the man cannot stop churning. Eleven moves a week is a personality, not a strategy. 🎡

Elsewhere: YMVtheDAD added Jordan Love, watched him go 17.8 on the bench while Joe Burrow started for 20.2 (fine, actually correct, we'll allow it), then traded Kenyon Sadiq for Kayshon Boutte and back again within the same week. Hvang94 signed Carson Wentz and got 6.3. mouavang86 signed Konata Mumpfield, started him for 1.7, and left Jalen Coker's 10.6 on the bench — the SECOND straight week he's benched Coker and won anyway. That man is playing a different sport. 😎

sections.heading: STANDINGS: THREE UNBEATENS AND A CURSED BASEMENT 📊
sections.body:
Tub89's Hmoob Meka Hiluss is 2-0 and leads the league at 231.34 points for, and he's done it without Justin Jefferson (7.0) or Justin Herbert (9.9) doing anything in Week 2. Hvang94 is also 2-0, still named Not good, Just lucky, still accurate — he started Carson Wentz (6.3) and Dallas Goedert (0.9) and won by 12.64. mouavang86 rounds out the unbeatens at 2-0 by winning both games by a combined 12.57. 🪡

The cruelest line in the whole table belongs to ChunckyM: 251.83 points scored, most in the league by six, record 1-1. Same story for imbackbeech at 246.02. Meanwhile muahuavang has surrendered 278.86 points against — fifty-seven more than anyone else on earth — and sits 0-2 despite scoring more than four teams with wins. 🎻

The 0-2 club: muahuavang, Keeneng, and VangMushu, whose 171.11 points for is dead last and whose Week 2 leading scorer was the Minnesota defense. Fifteen weeks left. Start the guy who scored 35, not the guy who scored 6. 🤡
